items.raw_excerpt: Entre a neve, a agricultura e a pastorícia, o Coentral Grande, em Castanheira de Pera, teve também uma pequena indústria…
items.summary_en: Coentral Grande is a small village in the Serra da Lousa mountains of Portugal. Beyond farming and sheep herding, it once ran a tiny industry that made socks and gloves. That small workshop gave the village a way to earn a living.

items.title_en: The Hidden Mountain Village That Made Socks and Gloves

items.raw_excerpt: Writer and actor Eddie Perfect's next show is a black comedy based on Molière's Tartuffe that replaces the 17th-century play's quasi-religious charlatan with an AI hairdressing robot.
items.summary_en: Australian writer and actor Eddie Perfect has a new black comedy at Malthouse Theatre. It reworks Moliere's Tartuffe by replacing the religious fraud with an AI hairdressing robot. The show is planned for the 2027 season.
